lines: Well, I'll be! I just fell out of a green sky!
I'm Heather, sugar. You alright?
Folks here look scared of us. Let's say hello proper.
Well, hey there, sugar! I'm Heather.
{player}: Melody's written a new song, and she won't sing it without you!
A new song? I'm comin'! Meet you at the Market!
The Market Square, sugar! Melody needs me up front.
Howdy, sugar! Can I tag along with you?
Need rain or a rainbow? Press {showers}!
Yay! I'll be right behind you. Press {friend} any time you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
Still want me along? I'm ready when you are!
Yay! I'll be right behind you. Press {friend} any time you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
Well, hey there, sugar!
I'm Heather. I came from a farm, a long WHEN from here.
{player}: Do you like it here?
I sure do! The grass tastes like candy floss!
{player}! My blossom trees came through! An orchard by Glenmoor's door!
Two Fluffkins snuck through too. Little rascals.
April Showers: {showers_how}. Hop as you land to Spring Step!
Mornin'! The springiest grass in town. Give it a bounce!
Watch this! Ha! Moo-ve over, Dash!
The water here glows. And has aliens in it!
Portal's open, hon. Ain't that somethin'?

rotate: My best friend says 'wee'. I say 'y'all'.
Bramble says I can out-stubborn a carrot.
My farm song? ...Moooo. That's the whole song.
